collection_offset_description: Explicit offset for a subsequent page announced by the previous read.
collection_path_description: Exact path of a collection marked in the catalog, also present in paths. The same call opens a bounded page of its proven members.
description: Open the exact content of active personal souvenirs from exact paths selected in the catalog supplied to the voice. Reading is bounded to eight souvenirs; the catalog alone is never a source of facts.
established_description: People, place, time, constraints or other established conditions that may change the response. Include the current social and physical setting, not only the subjects of the latest sentence. A still-unknown property neither downgrades nor removes an already-established condition.
handling_description: Pre-reading conduct hypothesis. It will be reassessed from the exact bodies and must never prevent opening them.
mode_description: Pre-reading hypothesis: if an unknown remains after the exact bodies, clarify asks the single question then waits without composing the decision that depends on it, and condition states the condition first. If reading resolves the unknown, direct becomes possible again.
need_description: Precise item the souvenirs must establish or complete before responding.
paths_description: One to eight canonical paths copied exactly from the catalog, without brackets or the .md extension.
plan_description: With clarify, the single exact natural question; the voice then waits without composing any dependent choice. With condition, the exact condition preceding any dependent proposal. With direct, a brief internal justification.
scene_description: Minimal assessment of the whole situation before reading, drawn from the message and the entire scene rather than just the selected paths.
uncertain_description: Contingent unknowns in the current scene that would materially change the response, one per entry and only if the response must expose them at the requested level of precision. Do not include only the durable preferences the read must retrieve. Name the exact missing detail: an unknown about one property does not make another already-established fact uncertain or remove it from the decision scope. The scope itself is uncertain only if several readings of the episode genuinely remain possible.
